entries.title: Esther 5:3
segments: God often favors his people, not only equal to, but beyond their expectations; doing for them exceeding abundantly above all that they ask or think; and the surest way of obtaining the favor of men, is first to secure the favor of God.

entries.title: Esther 5:6
segments: Although men are prone to change, and but little dependence can be placed upon their promises, God can keep them of one mind as long as the good of his people requires.

entries.title: Esther 5:8
segments: Though delays are often dangerous, yet sometimes they are essential to success; and wisdom from above is needful in order to judge rightly as to the time as well as the manner of attempting to execute difficult and important designs.

entries.title: Esther 5:11
segments: No favors of mere creatures can satisfy the wants of the soul, or keep it from being wretched while seeking supremely its own glory, regardless of the glory of God and the good of mankind.

entries.title: Esther 5:13
segments: All this availeth me nothing; it did nothing towards makng him happy, or satisfying the wants of his soul.

entries.title: Esther 5:14
segments:
Fifty cubits high; about seventy-five feet. 
 
  Go thou in merrily; being relieved from thy trouble by the death of Mordecai. 
 
The measures which men take for the destruction of others often prove the means of their own; and while they glory in anticipated victory, they sink into irretrievable ruin.
